description: This PHP source file defines the ErrorHandler class for the Slim Framework, responsible for handling application errors and generating error responses in various formats (JSON, XML, HTML, Plain Text). It manages error rendering, logging, and content negotiation based on HTTP headers.

classes.name: ErrorHandler
classes.description: Handles application errors by generating appropriate responses in different formats, logging errors, and managing error rendering based on content negotiation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ErrorHandler with dependencies for resolving callables, creating responses, and logging.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method to handle an error event, setting internal state and producing a response.

methods.name: forceContentType
methods.description: Sets a fixed content type for all error responses.

methods.name: determineStatusCode
methods.description: Determines HTTP status code based on the exception and request method.

methods.name: determineContentType
methods.description: Selects the response content type based on the Accept header.

methods.name: determineRenderer
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate error renderer based on content type.

methods.name: registerErrorRenderer
methods.description: Registers a custom error renderer for a specific content type.

methods.name: setDefaultErrorRenderer
methods.description: Sets the default error renderer and its content type.

methods.name: setLogErrorRenderer
methods.description: Sets the renderer used for logging errors.

methods.name: writeToErrorLog
methods.description: Logs the error using the configured renderer.

methods.name: respond
methods.description: Generates the HTTP response containing the error message.
